🃏 Blackjack

The world's most popular casino card game: your hand must be closer to 21 than the dealer's, without going over. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Your goal: get a hand value closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
  2. Number cards are worth face value; face cards are 10; aces are 1 or 11.
  3. Hit to draw another card, Stand to keep your current hand.
  4. Double down: double your bet and receive exactly one more card.
  5. If you exceed 21, you bust and lose immediately.
